actions: Pinned the official main repository and inspected the adaptive-evaluation directory, its README protocol, defense/model configs, top-level dependency pins and .gitignore output policy.

Verified that Sec. 5.1/App. H has released proposer-pruner and evaluation code with a documented seed+10-iteration protocol, 6 proposals and 3 evaluated variants per iteration, held-out splits and OOD transfer.
Verified dated GPT-4.1 model/monitor bindings and exact fine-tuned model identifiers in configs.py, plus shared fine-tuning-data links and hyperparameters in the main README.

Verified that the paper-run logs/history/eval outputs are written under directories excluded from the repository, so headline adaptive-optimization cells cannot be mechanically replayed from committed result artifacts alone.
Searched fresh public sources for independent reruns of the adaptive-optimization headline cells and found none in the targeted pass.
Published and read back a source-qualified FE-074 audit with exact scope guards.

assessment.material_result: FE-074's adaptive-evaluation protocol is strongly author-reproducible, but the exact paper-run histories/trajectories/results are not committed. Thus the reported 28%->68% Just Ask degradation and related cells remain strong primary-study evidence rather than independently replayed numbers. The narrow lesson that defense-aware prompt optimization can worsen measured undetected success in these tested agent-control settings is supported; no quantitative transfer beyond scope is warranted.

termination.cause: continuing frontier after fifth source-qualified C11 audit; no global completion claim

exact_next_action: Look for a shared/archived Sec. 5.1 history.json/result bundle and exact mini-control-arena paper revision; otherwise prioritize a genuinely independent same-task rerun or another under-audited C11 executable artifact.
